description: Convert between the Korean lunar calendar (음력) and the Gregorian calendar using the Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute standard, with leap months (윤달) and 간지. Korean and Chinese lunar dates differ in some years (2027 Lunar New Year: Korea Feb 7, China Feb 6), so do not use a Chinese lunar library for Korean dates. For a lunar birthday or memorial day (제사) give lunar_month_day and years to get the solar date in each year. With no arguments it returns today's lunar date in Korea. Range: lunar 1000-01-01 to 2050-11-18.

leap_month.description: lunar_date is in a leap month (윤달). Default false.

lunar_date.description: Lunar date YYYY-MM-DD to convert to Gregorian

lunar_month_day.description: Lunar MM-DD repeated every year, e.g. 08-15; use with years

solar_date.description: Gregorian date YYYY-MM-DD to convert to lunar

name: kr_lunar_convert
title: Korean lunar calendar conversion (음력 ↔ 양력)
